options.name: Arcane Accuracy
options.benefit: Spend 1 arcane-pool point as a swift action to add Intelligence to attack rolls until the end of the turn.

options.name: Broad Study
options.benefit: Use spell combat and spellstrike with spells from one other spellcasting class.

options.name: Close Range
options.benefit: Deliver a ranged-touch spell through spellstrike as a melee touch spell.

options.name: Critical Strike
options.benefit: After confirming a critical hit, cast a touch spell as a swift action without provoking.

options.name: Dispelling Strike
options.benefit: Spend arcane-pool points after a weapon hit to apply dispel magic to the target.

options.name: Empowered Magic
options.benefit: Once per day cast one spell as though using Empower Spell without increasing its slot.

options.name: Familiar
options.benefit: Gain a familiar using Magus level as Wizard level.

options.name: Hasted Assault
options.benefit: Spend 1 arcane-pool point to gain haste for a number of rounds equal to Intelligence modifier.

options.name: Maximized Magic
options.benefit: Once per day cast one spell as though using Maximize Spell without increasing its slot.

options.name: Prescient Attack
options.benefit: Spend 1 arcane-pool point after a hit to deny the target Dexterity to AC against your attacks for the turn.

options.name: Reflection
options.benefit: Spend arcane-pool points to reflect a spell that fails to overcome your spell resistance.

options.name: Wand Wielder
options.benefit: Use a wand or staff in place of casting a spell during spell combat.
